title: Identification of pyroptosis-related lncRNA signature and AC005253.1 as a pyroptosis-related oncogene in prostate cancer
summary: The resulting prognostic signature included AC005253.1; cell assays supported its association with proliferation, migration and invasion. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: The resulting prognostic signature included AC005253.1; cell assays supported its association with proliferation, migration and invasion.
evidence.unknown: The source-checked evidence does not establish broader external validity or prospective benefit. Affiliation was not available in the retrieved trusted primary metadata.
evidence.ai_role: Survival random forest and LASSO selected a pyroptosis-related lncRNA signature from TCGA/GEO expression data.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
